question:
A radioactive nuclide $A$ decays to $B$ which is also radioactive:

$$A\xrightarrow{\lambda_1}B\xrightarrow{\lambda_2}C\, (\text{stable})$$

Initially, at $t=0$, there are $N_{A0}=1.0\times 10^{12}$ nuclei of $A$ and none of $B$. Half-lives are:

$$T_{1/2,A}=6\,\text{h},\qquad T_{1/2,B}=1\,\text{h}$$

At time $t=2\,\text{h}$, find the activity of $B$, $A_B(t)$ (in Bq).</n
Use</br>
$$\lambda=\frac{\ln 2}{T_{1/2}},\quad N_B(t)=\frac{\lambda_1 N_{A0}}{\lambda_2-\lambda_1}\left(e^{-\lambda_1 t}-e^{-\lambda_2 t}\right),\quad A_B=\lambda_2 N_B$$
